content.title: Houston Astros vs Athletics Live Stream: How to Watch MLB
content.text: The Athletics go for their second straight win on Saturday afternoon when they host the Astros in Sacramento The Athletics will look to clinch their first series win of the season when they play the Houston Astros on Saturday afternoon. The Athletics got their second win in three games when they exploded for 11 runs in a seven-run win over the Astros on Friday. The Athletics had lost their first four games of the season, but they now sit at 2-5. They are in last place in the AL West, but are just a half-game back of the Los Angeles Angels. The Athletics will send Luis Morales to the mound in the middle game of the series on Saturday afternoon. Morales comes into the game 0-1 with a 10.38 ERA. It was a rough first start as he gave up five runs in just 4.1 innings against the Toronto Blue Jays. The Astros will counter with Tatsuya Imai as they try to even the series on Saturday afternoon against the Athletics. Imai will be making his second start for the Astros after signing with them in the offseason from Japan. He wasn’t great in his first outing, as he gave up four runs in just 2.2 innings against the Angels. The Astros would still win the game 9-7, though. The loss on Friday night snapped a five-game winning streak for the Astros and dropped them to 5-3 on the season. They are at the top of the AL West, a half-game up on the Texas Rangers.
